text:
emma: Quick heads-up — draft release notes are up in the doc and I want to lock the internal announce cadence. Please eyeball and call out any consumer-facing blockers by EOD.

samir: link?

emma: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/drafts/175. Put comments on the headings. Key asks: confirm rollback criteria, pinning for models, and deploy window.

olivia: skimming now. For rollback we should confirm which model hashes are eligible for immediate rollbacks vs require db migration review.

nate: pinging deploy-bot to schedule staging run and canary flags.

deploy-bot: [bot] scheduled: staging rollout for release/175 at 2024-09-12T18:00Z. Canary group: 5% traffic, region us-west-2 first. Rollback window: 30m after canary, automatic fallback enabled.

jen: thanks — do we have the pinned model version? I thought we were switching to v2-quantized for cheaper tails.

emma: yes: primary model pinned to model-redwood/v2-q1 (digest: sha256:8f3a...), fallback is v2-fp16. Add to release notes under "Model pinning".

lily: microcopy check: internal announce should include "who to contact" and a short TL;DR with expected user impact (none for existing users).

samir: ops question — change window is midnight->02:00 PT to avoid peak. Does that conflict with EU batch jobs?

emma: good catch. EU nightly jobs run 01:30-02:15 PT. Let's move to 02:30-04:30 PT and call it out in the notes.

deploy-bot: [bot] updated: staging rollout rescheduled to 2024-09-13T02:30Z. Canary still 5%.

nate: can we set the canary to geo-split: US first then EU after successful metrics?

emma: yes — canary phased. Add in runbook: phase 1 US-west -> phase 2 EU-west. Rollback trigger: >5% error rate or >20% latency regression sustained for 5m.

olivia: adding a short checklist to the doc: QA sign-off, load test summary, DB migration noop, model hash verification.

jen: will draft the internal announcement blurb. Proposed short copy: "Deploying release 175 — performance improvements and cost optimizations for model inference. No user-facing changes expected. Standby: @nate @samir @olivia." Agree?

lily: yep. Maybe add where to find canary dashboards and logs (console -> releases/175).

samir: final ask — include exact rollback steps: 1) flip routing to fallback model 2) disable batching optimization 3) revert config in dedicated pool if needed.

emma: good. I'll add numbered rollback steps and assign owners.

deploy-bot: [bot] reminder: please add deploy checklist label `release/175/ready` when all done.

nate: doing a last pass on infra playbook, will drop load test summary by 16:30 PT.

jen: I'll post the internal announce at T-30m in #all-hands and pin the doc in eng-releases.

emma: thanks all. If no objections I’ll lock the notes at 17:00 PT and trigger the deploybot label. :thumbsup:
